# Perspective and Multidimensional Equations

## Geometry
`||x|| = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2)` and `<x,y> = sum_i x_i y_i`.

Affine transform: `x' = A x + b`.

Tensor contraction: `C_ij = sum_k A_ik B_kj`.

## Perspective
An observer is represented by origin/reference `o` and projection `P`: `y = P(x-o)`. This models representation, not a claim that an observer creates physical geometry.

A perception overlay can be represented as `z = f(Px, context, uncertainty)` where `f` is an application-defined inference function.

## Probability and quantum mechanics
Classical probabilities satisfy `sum_i p_i = 1`.
A pure quantum state satisfies `<psi|psi> = 1`; the Born rule is `p(i)=|<i|psi>|^2`.
Unitary evolution is `|psi(t)> = U(t)|psi(0)>` and the Schrödinger equation is `i hbar d|psi>/dt = H|psi>`.
A density matrix evolves as `rho' = U rho U^dagger`.

## Fourier analysis
`X_k = sum_n x_n exp(-2 pi i k n/N)`.

## 128D research framework
The Chimera 128D model is a configurable computational semantic space. It can encode geometry, state, properties, events, observer/perception features and application variables. It is **not** asserted here as experimentally established 128-dimensional physical spacetime.
